stalls.title: Stall alerts
stalls.hint: An item in the Inbox when a run seems stuck. Nothing is stopped or retried for you. 0 turns a rule off.
stalls.noEventsMinutes: A running turn says nothing for
stalls.noEventsHint: No events at all while the agent is working, not even a tool call.
stalls.sameFailureCount: A step fails the same way
stalls.sameFailureHint: Runs in a row that end with the same kind of error.
stalls.requestMinutes: A question or approval waits for
stalls.requestHint: Counted from when the agent asked.
stalls.cooldownHint: How long the same alert waits before it can come back after it closes.

general.languageHint: System follows the Windows display language.
general.themeHint: System follows the Windows app mode.
general.densityHint: Compact fits more rows on a screen.
general.scope: Language, theme and density belong to this window profile, not to the database.

projects.rootHint: Start looks here for repositories to import, and new projects are created here.

notifications.enabledHint: Questions, approvals and limits. The Inbox and the tray count always show everything.
notifications.quietHint: No notifications between these times. Nothing is shown afterwards; it waits in the Inbox.
notifications.quietEmpty: Start and end are the same time, so quiet hours never apply.
notifications.approveHint: Only low-risk approvals: read-only commands and allowlisted build or test commands inside the worktree. Medium and high risk always open the Inbox.
notifications.limitHint: Hand off and Wait for reset on a limit-reached notification. Hand off goes only to the proposed standby and still respects its spend caps.
notifications.mutedHint: A muted project raises no notifications. Account-wide limit warnings still show.
notifications.testHint: Shows one notification now, even during quiet hours.
notifications.unsupported: Windows notifications are not available in this run.

startup.loginHint: Crewyard starts when you sign in to Windows. Off unless you turn it on.
startup.hiddenHint: Starts without opening the window. Open it from the tray icon.
startup.dev: Development build: Windows will start electron.exe with {{path}}.
startup.closeHint: While agents run, closing the window keeps them running and Crewyard stays in the tray. With nothing running, closing quits. Quitting from the tray asks first and names what it stops.

data.backupHint: A consistent snapshot, safe while agents run. API keys are not included: they are encrypted for this Windows account and stay in the secrets folder.
data.blocked: Restore is unavailable while agents run. Open runs: {{count}}. Stop or finish them first.
data.restarting: Restoring. The background service is restarting.

done.restore: Restored from {{name}}. The database it replaced is saved as {{safety}}.

confirm.title: Restore this database?
confirm.body: Crewyard replaces its database with {{name}} and restarts its background service.
confirm.safety: A copy of the current database is saved to Backups first, so this can be undone.
confirm.keys: API keys are not part of a backup. Keys stay in the secrets folder; profiles that do not exist in the restored database will not use them.

errors.data.path: Choose a .db file that is not Crewyard's live database.
errors.data.exists: A file with that name already exists.
errors.restore.agents_running: Agents are running. Stop or finish them before restoring.
errors.restore.not_database: That file is not a SQLite database.
errors.restore.integrity: That database is damaged: its integrity check failed.
errors.restore.not_crewyard: That database was not made by Crewyard.
errors.restore.newer_schema: That database comes from a newer Crewyard. Update the app first.

about.licensesValue: The licences of every package bundled into this build, and NOTICE
about.licensesMissing: Not found: this build was made without them

status.quietTitle: Quiet hours. Notifications are held back; the Inbox still fills.
status.updateTitle: Crewyard {{version}} is available. Open Settings to download it.
status.updateReadyTitle: Crewyard {{version}} is downloaded and verified. Open Settings to install it.

keepAwake.label: Keep the PC awake while agents run
keepAwake.hint: Windows does not go to sleep while a run is active; the screen can still turn off. Off unless you turn it on.
keepAwake.batteryHint: On battery at or below this charge, Windows may sleep again, even mid-run. On battery with an unknown charge it may sleep too.

now.active: Now: keeping Windows awake. Active runs: {{count}}
now.battery: Now: Windows may sleep. Battery at {{pct}}%, guard at {{min}}%
now.batteryUnknown: Now: Windows may sleep. On battery, charge unknown
now.idle: Now: no run is active, so Windows sleeps as usual
now.off: Now: off, so Windows sleeps as usual

mcp.title: Your MCP servers
mcp.hint: Stdio servers every run in a project gets, besides Crewyard's own. They are stored in Crewyard, never in the project folder.
mcp.reportNote: Every run also gets Crewyard's report server: agents use it to report progress, ask for input and propose follow-up tasks. It cannot start anything.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.argsHint: One argument per line. Prefer an exact version (pkg@1.2.3) to npx pkg@latest: a floating tag runs whatever is published when the run starts.
mcp.envHint: Secret values are encrypted with Windows DPAPI like provider keys and never shown again. Names that look like credentials must be secret.
mcp.checkNote: Check tools starts the server once with its env, reads its tool list and stops it.
mcp.readOnlyHint: Planners, reviewers, researchers and security reviewers:
mcp.readOnlyUnmarked: This server marks none of its tools read-only. Decide what read-only roles get:

warning.floating: {{spec}} uses a moving tag: each run may download a different version. Pin an exact version.
warning.unpinned: {{spec}} has no exact version. Pin one, such as {{spec}}@1.2.3.
warning.shim: A .cmd shim runs through cmd.exe; arguments with quotes, %, &, |, <, > or ^ are refused.
warning.not_found: The command was not found on PATH.

reason.shell_syntax: its arguments contain cmd.exe syntax a .cmd shim cannot pass
reason.read_only_unchecked: tools not checked yet, so read-only roles skip it
reason.no_tool_filter: this runner cannot limit it to its read tools

error.mcp.name_invalid: Name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter, at most 32.
error.mcp.name_reserved: "crewyard" is Crewyard's own report server; pick another name.
error.mcp.name_taken: A server with this name already exists in this scope.
error.mcp.project_required: Open a project to add a server for it.
error.mcp.command_invalid: Enter the command on one line.
error.mcp.args_invalid: At most 32 arguments, one per line, each under 1 KB.
error.mcp.env_name_invalid: Variable names: letters, digits and _, not starting with CREWYARD_ or ELECTRON_.
error.mcp.env_must_be_secret: This name looks like a credential; keep it as a secret.

mcp.usageEmpty: No run has started with MCP servers yet.

hibernation.label: Hibernate idle agents
hibernation.hint: When an agent waits on your answer with nothing running, its process stops after the time below. The run stays open and wakes with its own session when you answer or send a message. Only for runners that can resume a session.
hibernation.afterHint: Idle minutes before the process stops, {{min}} to {{max}}.

accountSwitch.label: Switch accounts of the same provider
accountSwitch.hint: When a step stops on a limit, an empty credit or its key's spend cap, the next account of the same runner and provider that passes the checks takes over: the same kind of account (plan or API key), signed in, more than 20% left, budget left, never a Claude subscription. It works whatever the task's fallback mode, and never goes past a task's own budget. Each switch shows in the Inbox and the task timeline.
accountSwitch.perTaskHint: On for every task while this is on. Turn it off for one task in its crew proposal or from a switch in the Inbox.
accountSwitch.terms: Some providers' terms do not allow using several accounts to get past one account's limits. Check the terms of each provider you add more than one account for. Crewyard never moves sign-ins or keys between accounts; each account keeps its own sign-in and key.
accountSwitch.termsRequired: Accept the provider-terms note before turning account switching on.

updates.unsignedBuild: Off: this is an unsigned test build
updates.current: Crewyard is up to date. Checked {{time}}.
updates.autoHint: Looks for a new version a minute after start and every 6 hours. It never downloads or installs on its own.
updates.autoOff: Off: this copy of Crewyard does not update itself.

off.development: Only an installed copy of Crewyard updates itself. This one is a development build.
off.platform: Updates are not available on this system yet.
off.no_feed: This build has no update feed, so it never looks for updates.
off.not_installed: This copy runs from an unpacked folder. Only the copy the installer put down can update itself.
off.invalid: The update settings this build came with did not pass their checks, so Crewyard does not look for updates.

updates.downloadHint: Before it can be installed, the download is checked against the publisher's signature. Nothing is installed until you restart.
updates.downloadHintUnsigned: This test build does not check signatures. Nothing is installed until you restart.
updates.unverified: Downloaded. Not signature-checked: this is an unsigned test build.
updates.installHint: Crewyard closes, installs the update and opens again. If agents are running, you are asked first.

refused.not_signed: Refused: the update is not signed. Nothing was installed, and the download was deleted.
refused.tampered: Refused: the update was changed after it was signed. Nothing was installed, and the download was deleted.
refused.untrusted: Refused: Windows does not trust the update's signature. Nothing was installed, and the download was deleted.
refused.wrong_publisher: Refused: the update is signed by someone other than Crewyard's publisher. Nothing was installed, and the download was deleted.
refused.check_failed: Refused: the update's signature could not be checked. Nothing was installed, and the download was deleted.

error.network: Could not reach the update feed.
error.feed: The update feed did not answer with a usable release.
error.checksum: Refused: the download does not match the checksum the feed lists. Nothing was installed.
error.signature: Refused: the update did not pass the signature check. Nothing was installed.
error.disk: Could not write the download to disk.
